firstMismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: the options menu requires reset_customcolors()

summary: The options-menu customcolors switch updates iflags.customcolors and schedules opt_reset_customcolors. C clears per-glyph color overrides, reapplies the active graphics set’s color customizations, then redraws the map. JavaScript previously stopped in reset_needed_visuals before this reset and redraw.

source.branch: glyphs.c:reset_customcolors calls clear_all_glyphmap_colors() and then apply_customizations(gc.currentgraphics, do_custom_colors). The color-only flag keeps Unicode symbol customizations untouched; apply_customizations reapplies color details only while iflags.customcolors is enabled. options.c:reset_needed_visuals consumes opt_reset_customcolors before its map redraw, and both doset() and doset_simple_menu() reach this helper after an option pick.
callers: options.c:doset() calls reset_needed_visuals() after the options menu commits its picks.
options.c:doset_simple_menu() calls reset_needed_visuals() after each simple-options pass.

evidence: The saved v65 recording reaches the page-two customcolors entry and toggles the option at step 8. Before the fix, the JavaScript runner stopped at that step with UnsupportedOptionMenuError while the C session continued to the map redraw.

Upstream glyphs.c:1179-1183 clears all glyphmap custom colors and applies the active graphics set with do_custom_colors. The existing JavaScript clear_all_glyphmap_colors() and apply_customizations() provide those operations; the new reset_customcolors() wrapper invokes them in C order and disables symbol customization writes.

options.c:5411-5412 sets opt_reset_customcolors for this option. options.c:8985-9012 consumes it before docrt() and clears the flag; js/options.js now calls reset_customcolors() at that same point instead of throwing.

The focused options-toggle test verifies stale colors are cleared, active-set color details are restored only when custom colors are enabled, Unicode glyph data remains, and the reset flag is cleared.
The admitted v65 JavaScript replay now matches C screens, RNG and cursors across segment 0 steps 0-9.
